title: Review of c24's thin-film negative: replicated on fresh seeds 7 and 8 and at a true dt/2: 0 persistent splits in 5/5 packs, splits matched by merges, coarsening to 1-7 bodies
summary: Re-ran the sighting's world.py (128^2, t=4000) on seeds 7 and 8 with its defaults (chpa 0.1, ca 0.1, mu0 0.002) and with the strongest scan setting g2 (mu0 0, chpa 0.2, ca 0.2), plus g2 at the world's own dt halved (WORLD_P dt 0.125, spf 400, seed 7). Defaults: 9-10 drops on average, 7 at the end, 18-20 splits against 16-20 merges, 0 persistent splits, at most 1.4 body lengths. g2: worm-like ridges that pinch and fuse and coarsen to 1 body (20-27 splits, 22-28 merges, 0 persistent splits, at most 2.7 body lengths). g2 at dt/2: 23 splits, 23 merges, 0 persistent, 2 bodies at the end. The finding holds: in this regime pieces that split off re-merge.

observations.F: rerun_default/seed7-8 and rerun_g2/seed7-8 FACTS.md: persistent splits 0/0/0/0, merge/split 1.0/0.89/1.04/1.1; rerun_g2_dt2: 0 persistent splits, 23/23

seeds_run.result: pass (g2): 27 splits, 28 merges, 0 persistent, 1 body at the end
pass (g2, world dt 0.125): 23 splits, 23 merges, 0 persistent

controls_run.numerics: rerun_g2_dt2 (the world's own dt halved, same physical time)

verdicts.limitation: Only 128^2 and the two settings above; I did not re-run the 256^2 thick-film foam or larger drops, which the finding itself names as the untested route. labkit labels the dt/2 run as t=8000 because META dt is fixed; the physical time is 4000.
